flights.purposeTitle: Pracovná cesta ministra zahraničných vecí do sídla OSN v New Yorku
flights.purposeDescription: MZVEZ SR ohlásilo pracovnú cestu ministra Juraja Blanára do USA od 12. do 16. júla 2026, kde Slovensko oficiálne predstavilo kandidatúru na nestále členstvo v Bezpečnostnej rade OSN na roky 2028-2029. Dátumy sa zhodujú s týmto letom, žiadny zdroj však neuvádza, že delegácia cestovala práve týmto lietadlom. Zhoda dátumov nie je potvrdenie.

fleet.notes: Government flying service, operated by the Ministry of Interior air unit. In service since 2016-06-14. ICAO24 from tar1090-db; type and dates from sk/en Wikipedia. Not present in the NSAT civil register (checked 2026-08-21), as expected for a state aircraft.
Remaining airworthy Fokker 100 after OM-BYC was withdrawn in February 2025.
Withdrawn from service 2025-02-11 and used for spares. Kept in the registry with activeUntil set so historical flights remain attributable; no positions are expected after that date.
Second A319 of the government flying service. Same caveats as OM-BYA.

sources.title: Informacia o vyuzivani sluzieb Leteckeho utvaru Ministerstva vnutra Slovenskej republiky
sources.notes: Government material, effective from 1 January 2021. Primary source for every operating-cost figure this project publishes. The exact session date is not recorded on the downloadable file; the material states its own effect from 2021-01-01. Its internal planning table is consistent with the 3 802 EUR/h rate (768 004 / 202 = 3 802.0), which confirms the figures were read correctly.

research.description: Priemerny dlhodoby rozpocet pri minimalnom nalete 600 h letuny + 600 h vrtulniky, bez mzdovych nakladov
research.notes: Explicitly excludes payroll. Covers both the fixed-wing and the rotary fleet.

research.description: Priemerna cena priamych prevadzkovych nakladov na hodinu letu na letunoch (priemer F100 a A319), obdobie 2018-2019
Dlhodoba priemerna vyska priamych prevadzkovych nakladov na hodinu letu na letunoch vratane poplatkov, po zapocitani roka 2020
research.notes: This is the rate the unit's own planning table uses for every listed ministry.

research.description: Rozptyl hodinovej ceny priamych prevadzkovych nakladov letunov na najvyuzivanejsich letiskach: 2 359,55 EUR az 5 300,75 EUR
research.notes: Low 2359.55, high 5300.75. The document attributes the spread to destination, weather, fuel price, handling price, passenger count and other services.

research.description: V roku 2019 bolo vykonanych 1400 letovych hodin na letunoch, z toho cca 840 nie pre ustavnych cinitelov alebo MV SR
Minimalny nalet na zachovanie kvality a bezpecnosti prevadzky: 600 letovych hodin na letunoch a 600 na vrtulnikoch
Priame prevadzkove naklady na hodinu letu na vrtulnikoch: 1 012 EUR (2018-2019), 812 EUR dlhodobo vratane 2020
research.notes: Out of scope for the tracked fixed-wing fleet, but needed to split the unit's shared budget between the two fleets.

benchmarks.label: Priame prevadzkove naklady letunov LU MV SR, dlhodoby priemer
benchmarks.notes: Mid is the long-term planning rate including 2020; low and high are the observed spread across the most-used airports. The two come from adjacent paragraphs of the same document and are framed slightly differently, so the interval is wider than a single-year spread would be.

benchmarks.label: Priame prevadzkove naklady letunov LU MV SR, 2018-2019
Podiel fixnych nakladov na celkovych nakladoch utvaru
benchmarks.notes: The project specification's historical indication of roughly 30 % direct / 70 % fixed. Our own derivation from the A4 annual budget gives about 72 % fixed excluding payroll, which corroborates it independently. Used only to check that the model is not absurd.

utilisation.notes: The only official annual utilisation figure we have for the fixed-wing fleet.
Minimum required to maintain competency, not an observation. Using it as the denominator more than doubles the fixed cost per hour compared with the 2019 actual.

fixedCosts.derivation: 9 885 780 EUR long-term annual budget at the minimum nalet, excluding payroll, less the direct operating cost at that nalet: 600 h x 3 802 EUR (fixed-wing) + 600 h x 812 EUR (rotary) = 2 768 400 EUR. 9 885 780 - 2 768 400 = 7 117 380 EUR.
fixedCosts.notes: Derived, not stated. The budget figure is official; the split between direct and fixed within it is our arithmetic, and it excludes payroll and capital entirely.

fixedCosts.derivation: 7 117 380 EUR organisation-level fixed cost allocated to the fixed-wing fleet by planned flight hours: 600 / (600 + 600) = 50 %. 7 117 380 x 0.5 = 3 558 690 EUR.
fixedCosts.notes: A second derivation on top of the first. Allocating a shared budget by planned hours is one defensible choice among several; a different allocation method would move this figure.
